params.caption: 🕹️ Nintendo lists 3DS Zelda: A Link Between Worlds as playable on Switch Online Nintendo has indicated that the 2011-era 3DS classic A Link Between Worlds can be played through Nintendo Switch Online, sparking fan hopes that the 3DS library is finally coming to Switch. Nothing official about wider 3DS ports has been announced, so expectations should stay in check. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 16:01 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 👥 @NintendoAmerica 👍 Like if you want 3DS games on Switch · 💬 Which one first? #Zelda #NintendoSwitchOnline #3DS #Nintendo #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
